capabilities: Render inline status tags as styled colored badges
Choose from predefined tag labels like todo, doing, done, and blocked
Color tags with predefined colors or custom hex codes
Add arrow indicators to tags via prefix syntax
Extend styles by editing the plugin's style.css
disambiguation: Not a tag manager; it only renders styled labels from ((tag|label|color)) syntax and does not index, search, or collect tags.
extras: Full documentation and a live demo are hosted at binarynoir.tech rather than in the README; invalid colors fall back to grey.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown tags as plain text with no way to give individual status or label tags distinct colors or visual emphasis.

relations.evidence: The same ((tag|label|color)) syntax is available in other tools. The VS Code extension is the main project
The same ((tag|label|color)) syntax is available in other tools.

summary: Inline tag renderer that styles Markdown tags written as ((tag|label|color)) as colored status badges with optional arrows.
